units.source_text: 今上和二公主下棋。

en.t: The Emperor was playing Go with the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 日色渐暮之时，霏霏小雨，颇饶风趣。

en.t: As daylight gradually faded, a fine drizzle fell, making the scene quite charming.

units.source_text: 菊花映着暮色，更增艳丽。

en.t: The chrysanthemums stood out against the dusk, looking all the more vivid and beautiful.

units.source_text: 今上看了，召唤侍臣来前，问道：“此刻殿上有谁人等？”

en.t: Seeing this, the Emperor called an attendant before him and asked, "Who is presently in attendance at court?"

units.source_text: 侍臣奏道：“有中务亲王、上野亲王、中纳言源氏朝臣。”

en.t: The attendant replied, "Prince Nakatsukasa, Prince Ueno, and the Middle Counselor, Lord Genji, are present."

units.source_text: 今上说：“叫中纳言朝臣到这里来。”

en.t: The Emperor said, "Have the Middle Counselor come here."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言便来到御前。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, immediately came before the Emperor.

units.source_text: 此人确有单独被召的资格，

en.t: He was indeed worthy of being summoned on his own,

units.source_text: 身上的香气远远便已闻到，

en.t: for the fragrance about him could already be sensed from far away,

units.source_text: 其他一切姿态都与众人不同。

en.t: and in every other aspect of his bearing he was unlike everyone else.

units.source_text: 今上对他言道：“今日时雨霏霏，比平日更觉悠闲。

en.t: The Emperor said to him, "Today the passing rain falls softly, and everything feels more leisurely than usual.

units.source_text: 未便举行管弦之会，实甚寂寞。

en.t: It is not convenient to hold a music gathering, so it feels truly lonely.

units.source_text: 为了消闲解闷，下棋这游戏最为适宜。”

en.t: To pass the time and ease boredom, playing Go is the most suitable amusement."

units.source_text: 便命取出棋盘，叫薰中纳言走近前来，和他对着。

en.t: He then ordered the Go board to be brought out and had Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, come closer and sit facing him.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言常蒙今上召近身边，已成习惯，以为今日亦是寻常。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was often called close to the Emperor and had grown used to it, so he thought today was no different.

units.source_text: 今上对他说道：“我有一件很好的赌品，

en.t: The Emperor said to him, "I have a very fine stake to wager,

units.source_text: 不肯轻易给人的，但给你却不惜。”

en.t: one I would not readily give to others, but for you I would not begrudge it."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言听了这话，不知作何感想，只是惟惟听命。

en.t: Hearing this, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, gave no sign of what he thought and simply obeyed.

units.source_text: 下了一会棋，今上三次之中输了两次。

en.t: After they had played for a while, the Emperor lost two games out of three.

units.source_text: 他说：“好气人啊！”

en.t: He said, "How vexing!"

units.source_text: 又说：“今天先‘许折一枝春’。”

en.t: Then he added, "For today, first I grant you leave to break off one branch of spring."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言并不答话，立刻走下阶去折取一枝美好的菊花，便赋诗奏闻：

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, made no reply, but immediately went down the steps, broke off a beautiful spray of chrysanthemums, and composed a poem to present:
